findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: company_profile, csv_preflight, dns_lookup, email_check · Private data: company_profile, dns_lookup, email_check, event_weather, sanctions_screen, wallet_risk · Public sink: csv_preflight, dns_lookup, email_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: company_profile, csv_preflight, dns_lookup, email_check · Private data: company_profile, dns_lookup, email_check, event_weather, sanctions_screen, wallet_risk · Public sink: csv_preflight, dns_lookup, email_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
